name: LoveSpark Panic Button
summary: One click to escape sensory overload. Breathing guide, grounding words, and a calm safe space. Built for ADHD.
description:
When everything is too much, press the button.

Sensory overload, anxiety spikes, and overwhelm hit without warning. You need a way out that's faster than closing tabs or finding a meditation app. LoveSpark Panic Button opens a gentle safe space instantly -- right in your browser, right when you need it.

FEATURES

- One-click or keyboard shortcut (Alt+Shift+P) to open a calm safe space
- Animated breathing circle guides you through slow, steady breaths
- Rotating grounding messages to anchor you in the present moment
- Escape counter tracks how many times you've used it (daily and lifetime)
- Sparky mascot provides a friendly, familiar face during hard moments
- Gentle visuals designed to reduce stimulation, not add to it
- 4 cozy themes (Retro Pink, Dark, Beige, Slate)
- Full keyboard and screen reader support

PRIVACY

- Zero data collection, no tracking, no ads
- No account required -- everything stays in your browser
- Open source (MIT license)

Part of the LoveSpark suite -- free retro pink tools for neurodivergent minds.
